finding.title: The code does not check if the input exceeds the buffer size, which can lead to a buffer overflow.
The code uses `atoi` to convert strings to integers, which can lead to integer overflow if the input is too large.
The code does not handle errors gracefully, which can lead to undefined behavior.
The use of `strtok` is not thread-safe and can lead to issues in multi-threaded environments.
